## How it was tested

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm run test:smoke` (if UI changed)

## Research rules

- [ ] No built-in, sample or AI-estimated figures; unavailable figures read Missing with a reason
- [ ] New data source has a row in `src/data/dataLicences.ts` and `npm run docs:licences` was run
- [ ] New signal or forecast was pre-registered before its first run
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`)
